attacks.name: Dragonfang
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!hit| |*Elusive|: After this attack is resolved, this character may Advance |!range_small|.

attacks.name: Geirr
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
If this character has Advanced or been Placed this Turn, it may add 3 dice to this attack roll. This special rule can be used only once per Turn.
|!wild| |*Vault|: After this attack is resolved, Place this character within |!range| 2 of the defender.

attacks.name: Fury of the Valkyrior
steps: Add dice to this attack roll equal to the defender's |!threat|.
|!hit| |!hit| |*Stagger|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§stagger§Stagger| special condition.

superPowers.name: Take Wing
superPowers.body: Place this character within |!range| 2 of its current position. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Need a Lift?
superPowers.body: During its Activation, when this character begins a move action within |!range| 2 of another allied character of |!size| 3 or less, it may use this superpower. After that move action is resolved, Place that allied character within |!range| 2 of its current position. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Guardian of Valhalla
superPowers.body: When another allied non-Grunt character is Dazed or KO'd, this character gains 1 |!power| and may remove 1 |!damage| or 1 special condition from itself.

superPowers.name: Asgardian
superPowers.body: During the |*Power Phase|, this character gains 1 additional |!power|.
